extracted.name: Crockpot Ranch Chuck Roast
instruction_lines: Rinse and pat dry your Chuck roast......
Place Chuck roast into your crockpot......
Arrange sliced onions and baby carrots all around Chuck roast......
In a bowl combine black pepper, minced garlic, beef broth, ranch dressing mix and flour......
Pour ranch mixture all over Chuck roast and veggies.....
Cover crockpot and cook on low heat for 8-10 hours, or until veggies are tender and Chuck roast is cooked thoroughly........
Let roast stand for several minutes, then serve and enjoy 😉!!!
